newsitem.title: UK: Climber cheats death thanks to rucksack strap.
newsitem.headline: Climber cheats death thanks to rucksack strap.

text.p: A climber who survived a 1,000 ft (300 metre) fall in the Scottish Highlands when a broken strap on his rucksack jammed in a rock crevice was recovering in hospital on Saturday with only a fractured arm.
Rescue workers said businessman David Farquhar had a miracle escape from certain death.
Farquhar, 38, was rescued by helicopter after other climbers used a mobile phone to contact police. Rescue workers told reporters they had expected to find him dead.
